metadata.evaluation: 2018 development/calibration; 2019 onward test; 2020-2021 reporting distortion flagged
metadata.selection: Frozen using 2018 one-week MAE only: ridge must improve >=5% over both baselines and win in a majority of LGUs; otherwise choose the better baseline. Test outcomes never choose the model.
metadata.intervals: Per LGU/model/horizon signed out-of-sample residual quantiles; at least 30 earlier targets observed by origin; expanding calibration; lower bounds clipped to zero.
metadata.gaps: Exact calendar lags; no imputation. Missing/suspect targets and required lags are unavailable; compare all models on common supported targets. Seasonal lag is 52 weeks (364 days), not an inferred week-boundary convention.
metadata.ridge: Separate LGU and direct horizon fits: log1p lags at origin, origin-1/-2/-3, target-52; annual Fourier harmonics 1 and 2; training-only scaling; lambda=10; >=52 complete training examples; nonnegative expm1 output, no bias correction.
